quests.name: Child of Nature
quests.text: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
quests.text: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.  Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

quests.name: Syndicate Sabotage
quests.text: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.

quests.name: Friend of the Kirin Tor
quests.text: Speak to Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.

quests.name: Shrewd Negotiations
quests.text: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.

quests.name: Syndicate Assassins
quests.text: Kill 12 Syndicate Footpads and 8 Syndicate Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore.

quests.name: An Alarming Request
quests.text: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.

quests.name: Key to the City
quests.text: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: A Way In
quests.text: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.

quests.name: The Syndicate Sting
quests.text: Break up the secret deal, and take the object being traded to the Syndicate. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

quests.name: Foreboding Plans
quests.text: Bring the Foreboding Plans to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.

quests.name: Valik
quests.text: Bring a mug of Southshore Stout to Valik in the Syndicate camp.

quests.name: Encrypted Letter
quests.text: Bring the Encrypted Letter to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

quests.name: Letter to Stormpike
quests.text: Take the Cleverly Encrypted Letter to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.

quests.name: Further Mysteries
quests.text: Bring the Decrypted Letter to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.

quests.name: Blood in the Streets
quests.text: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake.

objectives.text: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake

quests.name: You're a Mean One...
quests.text: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: You're a Mean One...
quests.text: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: What's the Big Idea?
quests.text: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

quests.name: Covert Extraction
quests.text: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.

quests.name: Strahnbrad Mystery
quests.text: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.

quests.name: Noble Deaths
quests.text: Bring 7 Alterac Signet Rings to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.

quests.name: Crushridge Bounty
quests.text: Gather 9 Dirty Knucklebones from Crushridge ogres in the Alterac Mountains. Bring them to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.

quests.name: Assassin's Contract
quests.text: Bring the Assassin's Contract to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.

quests.name: Stormpike's Deciphering
quests.text: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.

quests.name: Crushridge Warmongers
quests.text: Slay 15 Crushridge Warmongers, then return to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.

quests.name: Baron's Demise
quests.text: Bring the Head of Baron Vardus to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.

quests.name: Dark Council
quests.text: Kill 4 Argus Shadow Mages.  Bring the Head of Nagaz to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.

quests.name: The Ensorcelled Parchment
quests.text: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

quests.name: Cyclonian
quests.text: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.

quests.name: The Summoning
quests.text: Bring the Whirlwind Heart to Bath'rah Windwatcher.

quests.name: With Wind Beneath Your Wings
quests.text: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.

quests.name: The Web of Magic
quests.text: Bring the I'lalai Fetish to Abra Cadabra in Dalaran.

quests.name: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets
quests.text: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

quests.name: The Talisman of Kazdor
quests.text: Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone.

quests.name: Fool Me Twice
quests.text: Speak to Fahrad when you're ready to hear his plan.

quests.name: Mastering the Elements
quests.text: Bring the elements earth, air, fire and water to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

quests.name: Sealed Azure Bag
quests.text: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.

quests.name: Spirit Totem
quests.text: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

quests.name: Da Voodoo
quests.text: Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

quests.name: The Dragon's Journal
quests.text: Recover Zarla's Journal from the depths of Alcaz Prison.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
